name: unsafe fn drop_in_place (self)
rule: If T is not Copy, using the pointed-to value after calling drop_in_place can cause undefined behavior. Assigning through *self counts as a use because it drops the value again; ptr::write may instead overwrite the data without dropping it.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > * mut T { unsafe fn drop_in_place (self) }
expression: This requirement is not expressible in the supplied DSL: it requires a Copy predicate and post-call use observations, neither of which is available.
